maria_cs: Quick weekly check for Helios — focused on p95/p99 by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: chat_stream (rwd-7b-p) shows a persistent p99 tail during peak that looks correlated with a recent UI rollout. Sharing a tiny summary table and notes below. cc @eli_ops @sam_engineer

maria_cs: ```
Route             Model               Mode         p95(ms)   p99(ms)
chat_stream       rwd-7b-p            streaming    142       740
chat_stream       rwd-7b-p            non-stream   160       480
generate_text     open-instruct-3b    streaming    120       320
generate_text     open-instruct-3b    non-stream   110       260
embed             rwd-4k-embed        non-stream   90        110
```

maria_cs: Notes: peak window ~11:00-12:00 UTC, concurrent sessions ~3x baseline, error rate crept from 0.1% -> 0.6% for ~18min, spend bump ~+12% day-over-day tied to extra streaming tokens.

eli_ops: Streaming p99 of 740ms is the headline — is that from a handful of long-lived sessions or many short sessions? any traffic shape?

maria_cs: It's a mix. The metric query shows two patterns: few long sessions with huge context (KV cache pressure) + many short sessions due to the new "session preview". Link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/helios/latency?p=chat_stream (internal)

sam_engineer: My 2¢: 740ms p99 likely KV cache misses + fallback to full-precision kernels on some hardware for long contexts. Also streaming introduces more scheduling overhead — tail variance increases.
sam_engineer: Quick mitigation ideas: limit max_concurrent_streams per API key, increase prefix cache size for Helios, or adjust batch window for streaming to reduce variance. I can run micro-experiments.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Inference runtime patch "stream-batch-tune" deployed to staging at 1806123500.

raj_custsuccess: I pinged Helios PM — they confirmed a small client change (preview pane) that opens a stream per preview. They're willing to toggle it off if we recommend. Potential renewal risk if UX regresses, but they prefer performance over the preview for now.

eli_ops: If they can toggle preview off that's the fastest win. Also we should consider a short Dedicated burst commit for their busiest hour to stabilize tail while we tune runtime.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) @sam_engineer run streaming batch + cache experiment on Helios (label: helios-expt-1806) — ETA 24h. 2) @eli_ops prepare Dedicated burst proposal + cost delta for one-week trial. 3) CS to ask Helios to rollback preview toggle for 48h while we test. 4) Monitor p99, p95, error-rate and spend; escalate if p99 > 600ms for >30m.

sam_engineer: On it — I'll post run id and brief results when available. Starting with: bump prefix cache by 2x, reduce stream batch window from 50ms -> 30ms, and cap concurrent streams per key at 60.

maria_cs: Thanks — will follow up in tomorrow's check. :thumbsup:
